categories.main_business_segments: JF SmartInvest Holdings Ltd primarily operates as a next-generation stock investing assistant, providing financial software sales and services, securities investment advisory, and investor education. Its product portfolio includes stock quote software (SmartInvest App), Stock Learning Machine, Stock Navigator Series, Super Investor, and Jiuyao Stocks (small-amount series products). The company also develops AI-driven products such as JF Robo-Advisor, FinSphere Agent, and FinSphere Report to enhance investment advisory services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages artificial intelligence (AI), big data technologies, and digital intelligence to develop its products and services. It integrates AI into investment advisory tools, content production, and operational management, including conversational stock investing assistants and intelligent research report generation. The Stock Learning Machine combines hardware, AI, and investment research systems to deliver comprehensive educational content. The company continuously invests in R&D, holding numerous software copyrights and patents related to AI and big data.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JF SmartInvest serves individual investors seeking equity investment tools, advisory services, and investor education. Its products cater to a broad customer base, including those interested in large-amount software products and small-amount series products, addressing diverse investment needs. The company also targets long-tail markets and aims to enhance investor education and rational investing concepts among its users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and primary markets are located in the People's Republic of China (PRC), with headquarters and major business locations in Shanghai and Hong Kong. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and participates in the Hong Kong Stock Connect program, facilitating access to Hong Kong and mainland Chinese capital markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: JF SmartInvest operates primarily in the downstream segment of the financial services supply chain, providing end-user financial software, investment advisory, and educational services. Its core suppliers include marketing service providers and technology infrastructure companies, such as media agencies, content creators, and technology firms, supporting its product development and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on a dual-driver approach combining technology and investment research. It prioritizes AI empowerment across product innovation, business operations, and compliance management. R&D efforts emphasize developing intelligent advisory ecosystems, enhancing AI applications in investment advisory, marketing, and risk control. The company also invests in talent development, team competitiveness, and expanding cooperation with securities brokers to create closed-loop services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through financial software sales and subscription-based services delivered via the SmartInvest App and related product lines. The company derives income from gross billings, which include cash received for software sales and services net of refunds. It also benefits from diversified revenue streams by offering multi-dimensional products catering to different customer segments and through value-added services such as investment advisory and educational content.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, JF SmartInvest positions itself as an industry leader in AI-driven investment advisory and financial software services in China. It emphasizes innovation, scenario application of AI, and a comprehensive product ecosystem to maintain market leadership. The company’s strategic upgrades and product diversification aim to strengthen its competitive edge in a highly competitive financial technology sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB2.306 billion, a 17.3% increase year-on-year, and a profit attributable to shareholders of RMB272.4 million, up 42.8%. The number of paying users grew by 149.4% to 181,543, and gross billings increased by 49.3% to RMB3.506 billion. The company maintains strong operating cash flow and has invested significantly in R&D, accounting for 13.8% of total revenue. Its gearing ratio increased to 57.7% as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JF SmartInvest differentiates itself by integrating advanced AI and big data technologies with deep investment research to provide personalized, professional, and user-friendly investment advisory services. Its multi-dimensional product structure, including the pioneering Stock Learning Machine, caters to diverse investor needs and promotes investor education. The company emphasizes a customer-centric approach, combining technology and research to simplify investment and enhance the investing experience, aiming to be a lifelong partner in wealth management.
